title: Check labels a model made
statement: Before building on labels a model made, have a stratified sample re-graded independently and require high agreement, above all on the in-between classes.
example: A re-grade of 30 stratified 'supported by the source' labels agreed with only 70% of them, below the 90% bar, and the training run built on them was blocked.
detail: The AP work built a training set whose labels, made by a model, said whether each span was supported by its source. A second model re-graded 30 stratified spans: agreement was 70% overall against a 90% bar and 60% on the middle 'partly supported' class against an 80% bar, with errors in both directions, and the training run was blocked until the labels were rebuilt (`icloud-work/aptraining/.agent/memory/MEMORY.md`). One span that added a claim its source paragraph did not make had been labelled fully supported. A later plan required at least 27 of 30 spot-checked preference pairs to be confirmed before training (`icloud-work/aptraining/.agent/memory/plan_v92_pipeline_distillation_single_model_2026_05_22.md`).
against: The re-grade was itself done by another model, not a person, so the 70% measures agreement between two models, not correctness (`icloud-work/aptraining/.agent/memory/MEMORY.md`). The 27-of-30 bar is a planned completion criterion, not a result.
